name: ReflectiveCard-TS-TW
blurb: Webcam feed rendered as a reflective, metallic ID card with distortion and specular lighting effects.
description: Captures webcam video and applies SVG filters (turbulence, displacement, specular lighting) to create a metallic, reflective card aesthetic. Includes adjustable blur, metalness, roughness, and glass distortion.
use_when: Interactive identity cards, sci-fi interfaces, or creative portfolio showcases where a webcam-driven visual effect creates immersion.
avoid_when: Privacy-sensitive contexts (requires explicit webcam permission), mobile devices with limited webcam support, or when users decline permission.
a11y: Requests camera access; gracefully degrades if permission denied (console error, no fallback content). No keyboard or screen-reader semantics — purely visual effect.
